  above hold across ten products.

_- Second round (same day): Ansys Discovery, Autodesk Fusion, nTop, and Flow360 as a found extra.
  - **Fusion** opens a Job Status dialog on solve, with per-phase progress bars (Upload, Mesh, Solve, Receive)
    and a progress bar at the foot of the Data Panel ([Fusion job status][fusion-status],
    [Fusion solve status][fusion-concept]). Progress beside the run, phases not residuals.

    ([Discovery forum][discovery-forum], [Refine stage course][discovery-refine]); no residuals inside the solve

    Manager][autodesk-jobs]).

  above hold across ten products.

a- Second round (same day): Ansys Discovery, Autodesk Fusion, nTop, and Flow360 as a found extra.
  - **Fusion** opens a Job Status dialog on solve, with per-phase progress bars (Upload, Mesh, Solve, Receive)
    and a progress bar at the foot of the Data Panel ([Fusion job status][fusion-status],
    [Fusion solve status][fusion-concept]). Progress beside the run, phases not residuals.
  - **Ansys Discovery** runs Refine solves with a progress display that users discuss on the forum
    ([Discovery forum][discovery-forum], [Refine stage course][discovery-refine]); no residuals inside the solve
    control are documented.
  - **nTop** imports CFD results and shades bodies with them (Surface Plot block, [nTop 4.15][ntop]); no solve
    UI of its own was found.
  - **Flow360** shows progress in a bottom status bar and convergence in an Analysis tab
    ([Flow360 GUI guide][flow360]).
  - Autodesk CFD's job manager shows per-job progress bars with thumbnails ([Autodesk Simulation Job
    Manager][autodesk-jobs]).
  None of these documents generated project art or residuals inside the Run/Stop control, so the findings
  above hold across ten products.

:- Second round (same day): Ansys Discovery, Autodesk Fusion, nTop, and Flow360 as a found extra.
  - **Fusion** opens a Job Status dialog on solve, with per-phase progress bars (Upload, Mesh, Solve, Receive)

    [Fusion solve status][fusion-concept]). Progress beside the run, phases not residuals.
  - **Ansys Discovery** runs Refine solves with a progress display that users discuss on the forum
    ([Discovery forum][discovery-forum], [Refine stage course][discovery-refine]); no residuals inside the solve
    control are documented.
  - **nTop** imports CFD results and shades bodies with them (Surface Plot block, [nTop 4.15][ntop]); no solve
    UI of its own was found.
  - **Flow360** shows progress in a bottom status bar and convergence in an Analysis tab
    ([Flow360 GUI guide][flow360]).
  - Autodesk CFD's job manager shows per-job progress bars with thumbnails ([Autodesk Simulation Job
    Manager][autodesk-jobs]).
  None of these documents generated project art or residuals inside the Run/Stop control, so the findings
  above hold across ten products.
- What a desk review cannot settle: undocumented UI, unreleased versions, and the long tail of smaller tools.
  "Not documented in ten products" is the claim this file supports; "nobody has it" is not.
